description: This file defines the SessionManager class responsible for handling user session management, including login, logout, token refresh, and persistence via Keychain in a Swift-based iOS application.

classes.name: SessionManager
classes.description: A singleton class managing user authentication sessions, including token handling, persistence, and refresh logic.

methods.name: restoreFromKeychainIfPossible
methods.description: Restores tokens from the Keychain and attempts to restore session state, refreshing tokens if needed.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs login with email and password, then persists and applies tokens.

methods.name: authorizedRequestToken
methods.description: Provides a valid access token, refreshing if necessary.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the user, invalidates the session, and clears stored tokens.

methods.name: refreshIfNeeded
methods.description: Refreshes the access token if it is expired or near expiry.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Updates in-memory tokens with new values.

methods.name: clearSession
methods.description: Clears session data from memory and Keychain.

methods.name: clearInMemory
methods.description: Resets in-memory token variables and authentication state.
